strings.Install triss-coworker via npm -g: 透過 npm -g 安裝 triss-coworker
strings.Local CLI and MCP server that delegates: 委派程式碼研究、審查與實作任務的本機 CLI 與 MCP 伺服器。
strings.Needs a supported provider API key; code: 需要支援的服務供應商 API 金鑰；coder 供應商全部回報缺少
strings.Needs a supported provider API key; stat: 需要支援的服務供應商 API 金鑰；status 顯示所有憑證皆缺少
strings.Review a branch, pull request, or diff: 審查分支、pull request 或 diff
strings.Run `triss status` to check that the too: 執行 `triss status` 確認工具已安裝並就緒。
strings.Run small, well-scoped coding tasks: 執行範圍明確的小型程式任務
strings.answer a focused question about files: 回答關於檔案的特定問題
strings.delegate a bounded implementation change: 委派範圍明確的實作變更
strings.execute bounded coding tasks: 執行範圍明確的程式設計任務
strings.get a second review of a branch or diff: 取得分支或 diff 的第二次審查

strings.triss ask requires provider credential (: triss ask 需要服務供應商憑證（TRISS_*、ZHIPU_API_KEY 等）－已驗證錯誤 TRISS_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN
